title: Qualify four selected Math Discovery CLR bindings against immutable published packages under isolated net11
commitMessage: test: qualify published Discovery CLR bindings on net11

contribution.summary: Verify the four selected Math Discovery CLR operations through an independent source-free .NET 11 consumer of the already published private packages.
contribution.value: Reuse the existing four-binding and five-example CLR seed consumer with only a locked Composition PackageReference, its exact IR and Quantities transitive closure, published archive/DLL SHA-256 checks and SDK 11.0.100 isolation. Bind selected fingerprints to existing source provenance without editing production packages or claiming an authorized broker or runtime adoption.
debtChanges: The selected Discovery operations had source-project CLR verification; RS256-RS261 individually qualified published IR and Composition binaries, but their combined four-binding consumer was not yet qualified as a locked published package graph.
The already published immutable package identities are Composition 20260.20261107.1001, IR 20260.20261104.1001 and Quantities 20260.20261102.1001; this run reads and copies, never republishes.
M8 and M9 native states remain not-ready, canonical statuses planned; the source-only Discovery receipt and runtime-only authorization boundary are not promoted by this test.
contribution.nextAction: If the independent binary consumer succeeds, reconcile that exact package-only Discovery evidence in a later bounded documentation decision; no broker readiness or cross-repository acceptance is implied.
